name: search_gpu_offers
description: Find single cloud GPUs (on demand) you can rent right now, cheapest first, across all tracked clouds. Returns price per GPU-hour in USD, cloud, stock level, regions and a link to rent.

arguments.name: gpu
arguments.desc: GPU id or name fragment, e.g. 'H100', 'B200', 'RTX 4090', 'h100-sxm-80gb'. Comma-separated for several.

arguments.name: region
arguments.desc: ISO country code or name (US, DE, Germany), an area (Europe, North America, Asia, Oceania, South America, Africa), a data center id, or a city

arguments.name: cloud_type
arguments.desc: datacenter = provider's own data centers; community = marketplace hosts (cheaper, less reliable)

arguments.name: pricing
arguments.desc: Default on_demand. spot is cheaper but the provider can stop it at any time.

arguments.name: vendor
arguments.desc: GPU vendor filter: NVIDIA or AMD

arguments.name: exclude_resellers
arguments.desc: Drop resellers and offers read through a reseller

arguments.name: include_unavailable
arguments.desc: Also return offers that cannot be rented right now (default false)

name: list_gpus
description: All tracked GPU models with VRAM, the cheapest price you can rent each at right now (data center and community) and how many clouds have it in stock.

arguments.name: gpu
arguments.desc: GPU id or name fragment, e.g. 'H100', 'B200', 'RTX 4090', 'h100-sxm-80gb'. Comma-separated for several.

arguments.name: vendor
arguments.desc: GPU vendor filter: NVIDIA or AMD

arguments.name: in_stock_only
arguments.desc: Only GPUs rentable somewhere right now (default true)

name: get_gpu
description: Specs and every offer (all clouds, in stock or not) for one GPU model.

name: list_providers
description: Every GPU cloud in the index, with its website, whether it is a marketplace or reseller, and how many offers it has in stock.
